label: PF Backlog 51
title: Intake E2E (backend): serve /api/v1/intake for all adapters + CORS/OPTIONS + auth + single port source
body: All 4 branded adapters (ChatGPT userscript+Custom-GPT schema, Claude userscript+MCP server, Gemini MV3 extension) POST to /api/v1/intake which the LIVE backend does NOT serve (only /api/intake exists) -> 404. Fix: serve /api/v1/intake (+ /upload-chunk, /upload-complete) from the live backend; implement do_OPTIONS/CORS Allow-Headers so browser preflight passes; enforce token auth (adapters already send Bearer); make the port a single source (adapters read core/port_config.py; drift 8765/8000/3020 today); add the missing adapters/gemini/icons/. Refs: adapters/*, dashboard/server.py:214, core/intake_api.py (unmounted), core/port_config.py.

decisions.note: [P2] Intake E2E: serve /api/v1/intake for adapters + CORS/OPTIONS + auth + single port source.

dashboard_impact.reason: intake lifecycle surface exists (intake follow-up + parked management)
